title: Chick Webb in ads; hi-hat, tempo blocks and the "run around"
summary: Webb appeared in drum ads and McRae describes his use of hi-hat and tempo blocks.

blocks.x: Didn't Chick Webb get featured in a couple of ads for drum companies?

Yeah. Cymbals too. Well Chick made the hi-hat. He was the most successful guy with the hi-hat. He got more out that hi-hat than any drummer ever had. He say he was the one who brought it to the attention of all the drummers. And that hand thing he used to do that, the guys can do that. That hand cymbal. Where they (inaudible) beat on a stick? Had all that kind of stuff. And those (inaudible) blocks.

Tempo blocks, he used that a lot. He get more out of that than the drummer -- He had a lot of things. He used to make a break called the "run around." (humming notes) Everything on the drums. Cymbal, (inaudible). And it was -- it would make sense what he was doing -- it so great, man.
